movie.title: Vengeance
movie.overview: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Driven by grief, a decorated special forces hero uses a sudden fortune to assemble his elite squad and hunt down the syndicate responsible for his wife's murder.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When the wife of legendary special forces operative 'Toro' is brutally murdered, his life is shattered and stripped of purpose. A sudden stroke of fate leaves him with a massive fortune, allowing him to turn vast wealth into a high-tech arsenal. Reconnecting with his most trusted former squadmates, Toro launches an unrelenting campaign to execute everyone involved in the attack. Together, they wage a private war, ensuring no target can hide from their specialized brand of justice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Carlos, known in military circles as 'Toro,' is a decorated special forces hero trying to adapt to a peaceful civilian life alongside his beloved wife. That peace is shattered when a ruthless syndicate brutally assassinates her in a violent home invasion, leaving Toro broken and seeking answers. Devastated by grief, he finds himself trapped in a cycle of despair until an unexpected stroke of fate makes him an overnight millionaire. Realizing he now possesses the resources to wage an unyielding war, Carlos decides to dedicate every cent of his fortune to a single motive: ultimate revenge. He channels his newfound wealth into procuring military-grade weaponry, tactical gear, and cutting-edge intelligence assets. Recognizing that he cannot accomplish this mission alone, Carlos recruits his former special forces squad, a group of elite soldiers who share an unbreakable bond of loyalty. Together, the team meticulously tracks down every individual linked to the tragedy, unraveling a deep web of corruption and hostility. As they eliminate targets one by one, Carlos must navigate the brutal consequences of his campaign, proving that no amount of danger will stop him from exacting retribution.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Vengeance follows Carlos, a highly decorated special forces veteran nicknamed 'Toro,' whose world is torn apart by a tragic act of violence when his wife is brutally murdered. Consumed by grief and left with nothing to lose, Carlos's path takes an unexpected turn when he suddenly acquires a massive financial fortune. Rather than seeking a quiet life, he converts his wealth into a deadly tactical arsenal and seeks out his most reliable former squadmates. Fueled by brotherhood, loyalty, and an unquenchable desire for justice, the elite unit embarks on a dangerous mission to hunt down the powerful figures behind the hit, sparking a high-stakes war between seasoned soldiers and a dangerous criminal network.

story_structure.climax: Carlos and his battle-tested team launch an explosive final assault against the head of the operation behind the murder.
story_structure.conflict: Driven by grief and anger following his wife's brutal murder, Carlos commits entirely to seeking revenge against those responsible.
story_structure.resolution: With the confrontation concluded, Carlos must face the aftermath of his campaign and the reality of life after vengeance.
story_structure.introduction: Carlos, known as 'Toro,' is an elite military hero whose life changes dramatically after a tragic personal loss and an unexpected windfall.
story_structure.risingAction: Carlos leverages his new wealth to build a formidable arsenal, recruits his most loyal former squadmates, and systematically tracks down his targets.
